name: Jade Bird Fire Co., Ltd.
summary: Jade Bird Fire Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells professional fire safety electronic products and intelligent fire safety systems in China and internationally. The company offers fire safety systems, automatic fire alarm systems, small-area fire safety systems, gaseous suppression and control systems, fire door monitoring systems, electrical fire monitoring systems, civil and commercial emergency lighting and evacuation guidance systems, power supply systems for fire protection equipment, combustible gas detection and alarm systems, and wireless WAN fire safety systems. It also engages in the Internet of Things; software and IT services;…
